text:
Alex M: Quick heads-up — HarborPay VIP demo scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PDT. I ran the canary against v2.3.1 and saw tail p95 jump ~2.8x after the recent scheduler change. Not a hard outage but enough to risk demo UX.

Priya K: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the specific metrics and where to find the canary?

Alex M: Canary is in prod-canary cluster (region-us-west). Quick snippet: ```
# prometheus query (last 15m)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~340ms for short prompts. Error rate steady at ~0.3%.

Oncall Bot: [alert] prod-canary latency anomaly detected (since 2025-06-02T01:12Z). p95 increased 2.8x. No elevated 5xx. Runbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/canary-latency-checks :memo:

Sam D: I pushed a quick config change to autoscale.policy (lowered target_util to 0.6) but left it commented for now. If tail stays high through the afternoon, I'd flip it and watch. Rolling back scheduler change is heavier.

Priya K: I'm taking night coverage for CA->APAC overlap. I'll do an evening watch from 22:00 PDT. If p95 > 300ms for more than 10m OR errors > 0.8% escalate to page. Otherwise follow the mitigation checklist in the runbook. :thumbsup:

Lena O: FYI routing team — if you expect more traffic for the demo I can pre-warm an extra dedicated pool. That avoids fallback to lower-tier variants and keeps latency stable. Need a commit by 18:00 PDT to guarantee capacity.

Marcus S: I can do the morning overlap 08:30–10:30 PDT so there's a handoff window with the demo. If Priya pages overnight, I'll join the call for the escalation.

Alex M: Practical ops steps for whoever is oncall:
- Check canary dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/canary/harborpay
- Quick health curl: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.dev/health | jq .`
- If latency persists after scaling change, `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime -n prod-canary` (only if you have manager approval)

Sam D: Adding small script to monitor and post to this thread if threshold crossed. Will tag @Priya K and @Marcus S automatically.

Priya K: Perfect. I'll take 22:00–06:00 PDT watch, escalate per thresholds, and update the runbook summary in the morning with any deviations. No P0 right now but want to keep eyes on it.

Alex M: Thanks team. Leaving detailed notes in the customer-runbook page and I'll be reachable until 21:30 PDT for handoff. :white_check_mark:
